subject: Renewal QBR + Roadmap demo — NimbusHealth
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@NimbusHealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example>
Cc: Brian Cho <brian.cho@NimbusHealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — timing constraints

Hey Jordan / Marissa,

We’re starting renewal planning on our side and would like to lock in a QBR + roadmap demo before EOY. Execs are available on 12/20 or 12/22 only; technical folks prefer weekdays after 1pm PT. Procurement will need a short SOW to attach to the renewal packet.

Can you share a couple of narrowly scoped options (60/90 min) that include:
- 20m exec summary + business outcomes
- 30–45m technical demo (model performance, new batching/quantization controls)
- 10–15m next steps + procurement checklist

Also: we need a recording and a short runbook to hand to our ops team. Attaching a tentative attendee list below.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Liu
Director, Cloud Integrations | NimbusHealth
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.example>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@NimbusHealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — timing constraints

Sara — thanks for the details. 12/20 at 1:30pm PT would work for our execs and gives engineering time to join (we can compress to 75m). If you need 12/22 we can also make that work but prefer 12/20.

Proposed 75m agenda (we can tighten further):
- 0–15m Exec recap and renewal milestones (Jordan + Marissa)
- 15–55m Technical demo (Rishi + Monica): latency/cost improvements, new routing/fallback flows, and a short live walkthrough of the Optimize recommendations UI
- 55–70m Procurement + SOW action items (Jordan)
- 70–75m Recording, next steps, and signoffs

I’ll hold 12/20 1:30–2:45pm PT as tentative. Can you confirm attendees and whether procurement wants the SOW before or after the session? We’ll attach a one-page runbook and the deck.

Jordan Blake
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@NimbusHealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.example>
Cc: Brian Cho <brian.cho@NimbusHealth.com>, procurement@NimbusHealth.com
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — timing constraints

Jordan — 12/20 at 1:30pm PT works; attendees confirmed below. Procurement prefers the SOW ahead of the meeting (they'll fast-track if they can review during the same week). Also can you include a short section on audit logs/data retention? Our compliance lead will listen for that.

Attendees:
- Sara Liu (Dir, Cloud Integrations)
- Brian Cho (VP Product)
- Mei Tan (Compliance)
- Procurement team (watching)

Appreciate the runbook + recording.

Best,
Sara
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.example>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.example>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@NimbusHealth.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2027 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — timing constraints

Locked: 12/20 1:30–2:45pm PT. I’ll create the invite and include the recording permission. Rishi — can you prioritize the demo checklist below and confirm who will own the audit-logs/data-retention slide?

Run-of-show notes (attachment: 20271214_runbook_v1.pdf):
- 1:30–1:45 Exec recap (Jordan)
- 1:45–2:20 Technical demo (Rishi lead, Monica engineering demo)
- 2:20–2:30 Procurement + SOW Q&A (Jordan)
- 2:30–2:45 Next steps and signoffs; recording saved to shared Drive

Attachments included: runbook + updated deck (redwood_roadmap_deck_v3.pdf). I’ll mark the invite as private and set alternate dial-in in case Nimbus's calendar doesn't accept external ics.

Marissa Cole
Senior customer success manager | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.example>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.example>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@NimbusHealth.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Dec 2027 10:11:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — timing constraints

Thanks team — I’ll own the audit logs/data retention slide and surface examples of export formats and retention windows. Monica will run the live inference demo and validate a short prefix-cache example specific to Nimbus's 2-second latency target.

Action items for prep:
- Rishi: audit log screenshots + retention policy summary (attach one-pager to calendar)
- Monica: live demo run-through on 12/18 at 10am PT (internal dry-run)
- Marissa: calendar invite + recording/storage path
- Jordan: one-page SOW draft for procurement (I'll add a tech appendix)

I attached the engineer dry-run invite and a quick checklist in the runbook.

-Rishi
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.example>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@NimbusHealth.com>, Brian Cho <brian.cho@NimbusHealth.com>, procurement@NimbusHealth.com

Sara / Brian / Procurement team — thanks for confirming. Final notes before we lock: 
- Calendar invite: 12/20 1:30–2:45pm PT (attached as calendar_invite_nh_qbr.ics). Please accept so we can finalize room/dial-in.
- SOW: short draft uploaded to the shared Drive and procurement link (NH_SOW_docusign_link.txt). Procurement: let me know if you want changes before the meeting.
- Recording: we’ll record and share a trimmed version and the full runbook (20271214_runbook_v1.pdf) to your team within 24 hours.

If you want the SOW redline ahead of the 12/20 meeting I can turn it around by EOD tomorrow.

See you then,
Jordan Blake
